name: AFR 675 襟翼卡阻 滑出跑道 前轮陷地

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is AFR 675, a flight from Guangzhou to Wuhan, you have just been handed over from Guangzhou Control to Wuhan Control, you are over DAPRO, maintaining 10100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是AFR 675，从广州飞往武汉，刚由广州管制移交至武汉管制，过DAPRO，保持10100米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR 675, over DAPRO, maintaining 10100 meters.

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar indicates there is a cumulonimbus ahead, report the situation to Wuhan Control and ask for 20 miles deviation to the west.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的气象雷达显示前方有积雨云，请向武汉管制报告情况，并申请向西偏航20海里。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR 675, our weather radar indicates there is a cumulonimbus ahead, request 20 miles deviation to the west.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR 675，我们气象雷达显示前方有积雨云，申请向西偏航20海里。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 675, negative due prohibited area.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 675，因禁区不能同意。

cards.audioText: B: Now you find the navigation performance has been downgraded, report this to ATC and ask them to verify your flight track.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你发现导航性能下降，请向空管报告，并请他们核实你的飞行航迹。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR 675, the navigation performance has been downgraded, request verify our flight track.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR 675，导航性能下降，请核实我们的飞行航迹。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 675, you are still on track.
B: Your weather radar has failed, tell Wuhan Control you'd like to divert to Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的气象雷达失效，请告诉武汉管制你希望备降武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR 675, our weather radar has failed, request divert to Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR 675，我们气象雷达失效，申请备降武汉机场。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 675, turn left, direct to WHA, descend to 5100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 675，左转直飞WHA，下降至5100米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left, direct to WHA, descend to 5100 meters, AFR 675.

cards.audioText: B: Ask Wuhan Control for the current weather information at Wuhan.
cards.audioTextZh: 向武汉管制询问武汉当前天气信息。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR 675, request the current weather information at Wuhan.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR 675，请求武汉当前天气信息。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 675, the weather at Wuhan is fine.
B: During approach, you find your flaps are jammed, tell Wuhan Approach you want to terminate the approach and hold at WHA for trouble-shooting.
cards.audioTextZh: 进近过程中，你发现襟翼卡阻，请告诉武汉进近你希望终止进近，并在WHA等待排故。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 675, our flaps are jammed, request terminate the approach and hold at WHA for trouble-shooting.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 675，我们襟翼卡阻，申请终止进近并在WHA等待排故。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 675, direct to WHA, climb and maintain 900 meters, hold as published.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 675，直飞WHA，爬升并保持900米，按公布程序等待。
cards.referenceText: Direct to WHA, climb and maintain 900 meters, hold as published, AFR 675.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞WHA，爬升并保持900米，按公布程序等待，AFR 675。

cards.audioText: B: After completing the checklist, your flaps are still jammed, tell Wuhan Approach you intend to land at the longest runway, because the touchdown speed will be very high due flapless landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 完成检查单后，襟翼仍然卡阻。告诉武汉进近你打算在最长跑道落地，因为无襟翼着陆会导致接地速度很高。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 675, our flaps are still jammed, request land at the longest runway due the touchdown speed will be very high due flapless landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 675，我们襟翼仍然卡阻；由于无襟翼着陆接地速度会很高，申请使用最长跑道落地。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 675, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R.
B: Read back the ATC instructions and ask the controller the braking action of Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 675，可以ILS进近36右跑道。请复诵空管指令，并询问36右跑道刹车效应。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 675, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R, request the breaking action of Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 675，可以ILS进近36R，请问36R刹车效应。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 675, braking action Runway 36R good.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 675，36右跑道刹车效应好。

cards.audioText: B: You have skidded off the runway after landing, your nose wheel was bogged, report it to Wuhan Ground and request emergency assistance.
cards.audioTextZh: 落地后你冲出跑道，前轮陷住，请向武汉地面报告并申请应急援助。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR 675, we have skidded off the runway after landing, our nose wheel was bogged, request emergency assistance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR 675，我们落地后冲出跑道，前轮陷住，申请应急援助。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 675, the tug is on the way.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 675，牵引车正在赶来。
